data.one_liner: Humanize provides locale‑aware helpers to format dates, numbers, lists and file sizes for UI strings.
data.what_it_does: It offers functions to turn raw dates, durations, numbers and collections into readable, natural language strings. The package includes built‑in English and French support and works on all Flutter platforms.
use_when: You need quick, human‑friendly formatting for UI text without heavy i18n setup
Your app targets English and French and wants concise helpers for dates, numbers, lists, and file sizes
avoid_when: You require full locale coverage beyond en/fr
You need currency, complex plural rules, or calendar systems not provided
strengths: Lightweight with only intl as a dependency
Simple, chainable API for common UI phrasing
Works across mobile, web and desktop
weaknesses: Limited to English and French locales
Not a full replacement for intl's extensive i18n features
